content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes asphalt plants and aggregate and mining machinery for road builders, not oilfield well equipment or services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Sells perforating, completion and production enhancement products and well-site services to oil and gas operators, overlapping Weatherford's lines."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Rents and sells downhole drilling tools and provides field support to oil and gas operators, closely matching Weatherford's drilling tools business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO and pump products to general industrial plants, not oilfield drilling, completion or well services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors and builders, with no oilfield business."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Provides artificial lift, production equipment, rentals and field services to oil and gas producers, matching Weatherford's production systems."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Builds public highways and bridges under government contracts, a construction business unrelated to oilfield services."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pre-insulated piping for district energy and utilities, a product and project business different from well services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Performs inspection and repair for refineries and plants under maintenance contracts, not drilling or well construction services."}]}
